narrative_purpose: A decorative atmospheric layer for the chapter - a faint field of luminous root filaments dissolving into darkness, setting the night mood behind the text without competing with it.
subject: An abstract field of faint, branching luminous filaments - root networks and fungal threads - spreading and overlapping at very low opacity across pure darkness, like a nervous system glimpsed under leaf litter, fading toward the edges into void. A few barely-there moss cushions and spore points glow among them.
scene: Bottomless dark ground, the filament network suspended and receding, no horizon, no sky, only depth and haze.
camera: A drifting, depthless overhead field view with no single focus, filaments at varied scales and softness.
light: Very low cyan self-emission from the filaments themselves, most barely visible; deep indigo throughout, no external light source.
palette: Almost entirely void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, the faintest cyan tracing, no warm accents.
style: Painterly atmospheric wash, hand-painted haze, deliberately low-contrast and unobtrusive.
detail_level: Intentionally soft everywhere - a mood layer, no sharp focal point, filaments dissolving into dark.
composition: An even, edge-darkened field with no dominant subject, safe for text overlay, generous void.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, extremely restrained. A background plate only - must never compete with foreground text or figures.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no arrows, no high-contrast focal subject, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon or anime style
